title: QWEN / WEATHER MEMORY
dek: Four QwenCloud models pass one impossible forecast from language to image to moving sound
body:
QWEN / WEATHER MEMORY is PointCast Model Study 001: a relay across four models available through QwenCloud. Qwen 3.8 Max wrote a six-line impossible weather score. GLM-5.2 returned an independent counterforecast. Wan 2.7 Image Pro translated the premise into a 4096-pixel weather organism made of cloud, jellyfish, flower, barometer, reversed rain, and one private sun.

HappyHorse 1.1 then received the Wan still as its sole visual reference. It returned an eight-second 1280 × 720 moving passage with H.264 video and generated AAC audio: reversed rain, glass harmonics, distant wind, and a low pulse. The PointCast edition starts muted, asks before making sound, and falls back to the still when a visitor requests reduced motion.

The unusual part is the relay rather than any single output. Language becomes image; image becomes motion and sound; a second language model observes the same imagined weather from another angle. Every model output is pre-rendered. No QwenCloud token, live inference request, visitor prompt, or metered API call enters PointCast.
